parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the knowledge space. The description can be up to 512 characters in length.

parameters.name: EmbeddingModel
parameters.description: The name of the embedding model.

parameters.name: LLMModel
parameters.description: The name of the large language model.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the knowledge space. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: OSSBucket
parameters.description: The name of an existing OSS bucket in the same region.

parameters.name: RerankModel
parameters.description: The name of the reranking model.

parameters.name: ShardingStrategy
parameters.description:
The sharding strategy. Valid values:

- hierarchical (default)
- hybrid

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch for automatic creation of the database.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC for automatic creation of the database.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The active zone for automatic creation of the database.
